answer: Mirror-clustered rewards. Each epoch graders embed every answer; keys whose texts mirror each other above 0.9 cosine similarity are merged into one reward slot, like orchard grafts traced back to a single rootstock. A sybil farm must then pay for genuinely distinct reasoning per alias: at ~$0.40 of inference plus a 50 POA grading bond per fresh, gradeable answer, 1,000 aliases cost ~$400 and 50k POA every epoch. Copies polished smooth as marble earn nothing extra.
